functions.purpose: Client UI-model builder for the item-upgrade (equipment upgrade/refine) panel. Iterates the 'itemUpgradeDatas' variant array (records of 3 dwords: two-dword id/guid + nItemLevel), and for each entry builds a TASK_QUEST_VO_NAME view-object describing required upgrade materials and their current-vs-max owned counts, plus quest metadata. Uses CMaterialTagDescInfo lookups and two red-black-tree maps (CSkillLevelMap::Insert) to aggregate material requirements and skill/level contributions.
formulas: record stride in itemUpgradeDatas = 3 dwords: uStack_70 = *(u64)(base + idx*3 + 1) (item guid/id pair), nItemLevel = base[idx*3 + 3]
per material: nCurCount = FUN_113fa680(itemId,0,1) + FUN_113fa680(itemId,1,1)  (unbind count + bind count of owned item)
nMaxCount = required count = puVar14[1] (path A, CMaterialTagDescInfo entries stride 2 dwords) OR piVar5[6] (path B)
completion flag piStack_1b8/iVar22: stays 'complete' (==4) only if all materials satisfy curCount >= maxCount; set to 0 (incomplete) when iVar17+iVar6 < maxCount
material entry offsets (path A): puVar14[0]=materialItemId, puVar14[1]=requiredCount; rareType = ppiStack_168[0x13]
material entry offsets (path B, subTask): piVar5[0]=targetId, piVar5[6]=requiredMax; rareType = *(itemDef+0x4c)
costs: no currency mutation; reports material requirement counts (nCurCount/nMaxCount) and isPointMaterial flag for the upgrade recipe
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (populates flash/UI VO from local inventory counts). Reveals that upgrade-material sufficiency is a per-material curCount>=maxCount check that the server must re-validate on upgrade commit.
functions.notes: Keys emitted: subTaskArr, nItemLevel, nTargetID1, strTarget1, rareType, nCurCount, nMaxCount, isPointMaterial, nQuestID, nQuestStatus, nQuestLevel, strQuestName. FUN_113fa680(id, 0/1, 1) = owned-item count where arg2 0=unbind,1=bind. FUN_10254130(id)=item template lookup. FUN_1052bdd0/FUN_1052bdd0=quest name/def.

formulas: guidLo = param_4[8] if (param_4[7]&0x8f)==3||==4 else 0xdeadbeaf; guidHi = param_4[0xe] if (param_4[0xd]&0x8f)==3||==4 else 0xdeadbeaf
item = FUN_113f9bb0(guidLo,guidHi); if item==0 -> result 0x29812
else itemDef=FUN_11669250(); if *(itemDef+0x34)!=2 -> result 0x29813 (not equipment)
else if *(itemDef+0x34)==2 && *(itemDef+0xc0)==6 -> result 0x2981b

functions.serverRelevance: client-only pre-check/UI feedback. The itemDef type test (+0x34==2 equipment, +0xc0 subtype) and enforce-level read mirror validation the server must enforce on the actual enforce request.
functions.notes: Result written to param_1[2]; param_1 is a variant slot (tag at [1]). DAT_1202e818 -> +0xd0 -> +0x90 -> vtbl+0xb4 = local player/game-data accessor (recurring pattern this chunk). FUN_1166c160()=current enforce level getter.

functions.purpose: Emits the enforcement material ('diamond') cost and the enforce success-rate info to the VO. Reads the required diamond/material item id and count for the current enforce level, the player's owned amount, and a localized success-rate string. param_4 (char) selects live-equip mode (0) vs preview mode (1); param_3 selects whether bind materials are used.
formulas: cost source (preview mode param_4!=0): rec=FUN_115c3a10(FUN_115997b0(guid)); diamondPacked=*(rec+0xac), *(rec+0xb0); diamondItemID=*(int*)(rec+0xc4); diamondCounts=*(int*)(rec+0xc8)
cost source (live mode param_4==0): FUN_115999a0(equip,&packed,&packed2,&diamondItemID,&diamondCounts)
diamondBindCounts = FUN_113fa680(packed,1,1); diamondUnbindCounts = FUN_113fa680(packed,0,1)
diamondHasCounts = FUN_113fa380(diamondItemID)  (player total owned, emitted via FUN_104d1440 int64)
guaranteed/effective flag cVar6=param_3; forced false if diamondCounts<1 || diamondItemID<1
enforceRate = FUN_11599a70(item,cVar6) [live] or FUN_11599c50(item,param_3) [preview]; only when FUN_116698a0() true
enforceRateInfo = localized string msgId 0x48b (live) / 0x445 (preview), 1 arg = FUN_1024e8a0(enforceRate,2)
costs: diamondItemID + diamondCounts = material item consumed per enforce attempt; diamondBindCounts/diamondUnbindCounts split the requirement into bind vs unbind stacks
enforceRate = success chance (%) displayed to player
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display (reads local data / client-side rate helper FUN_11599a70). CRITICAL for the authoritative server: it exposes the enforce cost model (a per-level 'diamond' item cost at rec+0xc4/+0xc8) and a success-rate that the server must be the one to actually roll and charge. Gated on server enhancement config present (player+0x260e0 and +0x260e8).
functions.notes: Emitted keys: diamondItemID, diamondItemName, diamondCounts, diamondBindCounts, diamondUnbindCounts, diamondHasCounts, enforceRateInfo, enforceRate. FUN_113fa380(id)=total owned (int64).

functions.purpose: Emits the enforce-failure penalty (level-loss) info: a localized 'enforcePunishmentInfo' string plus maxLevel/minLevel fields describing how many enforce levels are lost on failure. param_5 selects normal-enforce vs alternate (transfer/break) message set.
formulas: penalty range: FUN_115998e0(item,&minLevel,&maxLevel) [normal, param_5==0] or FUN_11599be0() [param_5==1], only when FUN_116698a0() true
if maxLevel==minLevel && ==0: msg 0x487 (param5=0) / 0x4c3 (param5=1), 0 args (no penalty)
if maxLevel==minLevel && !=0: msg 0x488 / 0x4c4, 1 arg = FUN_1024e8a0(maxLevel,2) (fixed loss)
else (range): msg 0x489 / 0x4c5, 2 args = FUN_1024e8a0(minLevel,2), FUN_1024e8a0(maxLevel,2)
costs: on-failure penalty = loss of between minLevel and maxLevel enforce levels
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display of the failure penalty; the actual level-loss on a failed enforce must be applied authoritatively by the server. Gated on player+0x260e0 (enhancement config present).
functions.notes: Keys: enforcePunishmentInfo, maxLevel, minLevel. msg IDs 0x487/0x488/0x489 (enforce) and 0x4c3/0x4c4/0x4c5 (transfer/break variant).

functions.purpose: Builds the 'unified list' of shop entries (item ids/names, sale-point ids/names, valid shop ids) filtered by the player's eligibility. Uses CCurrencyInfo manager to resolve sale-point currency names.

hunt-rank gate: rec[0x1a] <= CPlayer__GetHuntRankOrCount(); if rec[0x1b]>0 also *(FUN_1083eb20(rec[0x1b])+0x18) <= huntRank
sub-filter: FUN_104d90e0(id)+0x58 quest/unlock check via FUN_114e0340
special ids 0x0a/0x1a/0x2c require FUN_1139ab70() true
sale-record time-window compare uses 64-bit now = FUN_111f8d20() against rec fields 100/0x6c (hi) and 0x60/0x68 (lo): available only within [start,end]
functions.serverRelevance: client-only display filtering. Encodes the eligibility rules (permission bitmask, hunt-rank >= requirement, level/time window) that the server must independently enforce before allowing a purchase of any listed item.
functions.notes: Emitted arrays: itemIdArr, itemNameArr, spIdArr, spNameArr, validShopIDs. FUN_1083e990/FUN_1083e900/FUN_1083e450/FUN_1083e4e0 = shop-data iterators. CInfoManager::FindByName('CCurrencyInfo') resolves sale-point currency.

functions.purpose: Core shop-page builder: for the requested page (param_4=pageSize, param_5=pageIndex) it filters the shop's sale records by class/skill/time filters, then emits a full SALE_ITEM_DATA VO per item -- ids, quantities, price, currency, buy-limit, player-level requirement, exchange (barter) cost items, and up to 12 special/discount item entries. Consumes EXCHANGE_DATA_CLASS records for barter costs.
formulas: sale-record offsets (ppiVar1): [2]=SaleItemId, [3]=shopID, [10]=ItemId(granted), [0xb]=ItemNum(qty), byte(+0xd)=UnBindGold flag, [0x1c]=currencyShowType, [0x1e]=itemClass1, [0x1f]=itemClass2, [0x20]=itemClass3, byte(+0x1d)=enabled
time window: rec[0x19]/[0x1b] (hi) & rec[0x18]/[0x1a] (lo) vs now=FUN_111f8d20() -> visible only within [start,end]
class filters: rec[0x1e]/[0x1f]/[0x20] must equal DAT_123bcf90/0x94/0x98 when those >0

exchange/barter cost list: rec[0x21]..rec[0x22], stride 2 dwords per cost item: [0]=costItemId, [1]=baseCount; actual cost = FUN_114b7110(rec,costItemId) + pair[1]; itemCount = pair[3]*rec[0xb] for material list (FUN_114b6f80(rec[0x16]))
currentCounts (owned of cost item) = FUN_113f9300(bag,itemId,0); if !bindable also + FUN_113f9300(2,id,0)+FUN_113f9300(10,id,0)
special items loop idx 1..0xd via FUN_108418c0; discount = rec[0x27][7]; special count = FUN_114b7530(currencyIdx) (idx7 also adds FUN_114b7530(8))
itemPrice = FUN_114b6660(saleItemId,shopId) (currency price lookup); needPlayerLevel = *(itemDef+0xc8); maxStackCount = *(itemDef+0x50)
page bound: total shown limited by param_4*param_5; pagination index tracked in uStack_124 (0..param_4-1) with edge flags 0/1/2
costs: purchase cost model: primary price FUN_114b6660(item,shop) in currency currencyShowType(rec[0x1c]); UnBindGold flag(+0xd) selects unbind-gold payment; barter cost = list of (costItemId,count) at rec[0x21..0x22]; special/discount multipliers at rec[0x27]
buy limit: currentLimitBuyCounts + itemLimitType (per-item purchase cap); needPlayerLevel gate
functions.serverRelevance: client-only VO assembly, but the single richest source of the shop PRICING & COST schema in this chunk. The server must authoritatively re-derive price (FUN_114b6660), barter cost items/counts (rec[0x21..0x22] + FUN_114b7110), buy-limit (currentLimitBuyCounts/itemLimitType), player-level requirement (itemDef+0xc8) and time window before committing a buy. isSkillFormula/isManuFormula/hasBeenLearned* gate purchase of skill/recipe items.
